title: Profile-Specific Round Trip and Nearest Encodable Point
objective: Prove forward and inverse behavior without claiming exactness where the source codec is quantized; separate the canonical exact round trip from the source-style calibrated round trip; return the nearest-encodable point and error region for arbitrary map points.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.local_coord (forward / inverse / local_barycentric) + spatialization; cwatlas.icosahedron - NOT reimplemented

implementation.canonical_exact_round_trip: route -> point -> route through the codec alone (CANONICAL_EXACT_POINT); exact by construction
implementation.source_style_calibrated_round_trip: route -> body location -> route through the fitted orientation + shell (CANDIDATE_CALIBRATED_POINT)
implementation.test_coverage: global random, pole, dateline, per-shell (0..8), epoch, and cell-boundary cases

claims.statement: Forward-inverse and inverse-forward are consistent per family: canonical route<->point<->route is exact by codec property, the calibrated round trip is exact under an orthonormal orientation, and arbitrary points return the nearest-encodable point with an explicit quantization error.

negative_results: The canonical exact round trip is a DERIVED_MATHEMATICS property of the codec, NOT a measured coordinate; it is kept separate from the source-style calibrated round trip which is only a CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE.

For an arbitrary map point exactness is not claimed: the nearest-encodable point and residual (quantization_error) are returned; near a terminal-cell edge/vertex the barycentric coordinate is reported as an interval/region, not a false-exact point.
The shell supplies the radius: with a shell present altitude is never missing - refuse_altitude_missing(shell) raises R1082ClaimError.
privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public routes and coordinates only; no private path literals, no personal identity tokens, no raw private narrative
